Unmodified files from `@noble/hashes` 2.4.0 (npm, MIT, Paul Miller): `blake3.js`
and what it imports, with their type declarations (only the sourceMappingURL
comments dropped). Vendored so the c0mpute edge keeps running from a plain
checkout with no `npm install` on the host. To update: `npm pack
@noble/hashes@<version>` and copy the same files over.
